      "observations": [
        "Folder update notifications now carry parent ID as well as ID/name through Rust, IDL and C++, enabling rename and reparent. The SyncFolderHierarchy delta gives update IDs; the follow-up GetFolder supplies details, correcting the earlier Bug uncertainty. Current Rust retains that details request before forwarding updated fields. Missing required fields reject at the checked callback boundary.",
        "Original UpdateFolderWithDetails only moves if name or parent ID changed, rejects a destination name conflict, then recursively copies each folder and metadata. It deletes copied placeholder child metadata before explicitly copying child content, and deletes the source after recursively processing its descendants. This is not a transactional or crash-safe move guarantee; some lower-level enumeration/delete results are not checked.",
        "The original mbox CopyFolder recursively handles children only if its destination QueryInterface to nsIMsgLocalMailFolder succeeds. Review temporarily accepts deferring the larger store refactor for ESR timing, but author then withdraws acceptance after a hierarchy test exposes this limitation. The final recursive helper and whole-tree test address that case; acceptance did not make the earlier assumption correct.",
        "After hierarchy sync can move the selected folder, GetNewMessages checks whether its old Exchange ID is still available and returns success instead of using an invalid object. Exact current account-route proof from2599 is reused. The fixed update implementation now calls LocalRenameOrReparentFolder in common OfflineStorage, whose checked no-op/conflict/recursive/notification behavior is later source, not an original general-helper implementation.",
        "New rename/reparent/tree tasks directly assert folder names/membership and preserved EWS IDs. Reviewer also requested sync-token preservation, and author says feedback addressed, but actual final tests assert IDs only. They do not directly assert token equality, persisted message bytes, copy rollback or all failure routes.",
        "Requested naming/comments are applied as MoveFolderRecurse, sourceFolder and ensureCreateFolder; source refers to a movable subtree, while the account root is a different special object. Literal arguments are a local consistency request. The review comment about abandoning a-prefixed names is not a new repository-wide rule."
      ],
